required_elements.criterion: Daughter and other villagers died days earlier in an epidemic, before any bear feeding.
Lack of crematorium/fuel in new settlement led to forest burial; father found disturbed grave during his regular visit.
Bear dug up and ate corpse; he shot it, but worried other bears could raid other graves and distress relatives, not kill living villagers.

acceptance: All causal narrative elements required, faithful paraphrases accepted. No arbitrary exact wording, names, counts or narrative decoration beyond rubric. Never give solver missing elements. False/incomplete final gets no and game continues.
